raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 12 holds rows ingested at two different times (02:00 and 22:00 on 2026-01-17), which points to a partial re-delivery of that batch. raw_transactions has 4886 rows but only 4866 distinct txn_id values, so 20 rows are re-sent copies, and 18 of those keys survive the POSTED filter as duplicates in silver_transactions and inflate every gold table.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT * FROM raw_transactions QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) = 1) d WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
